Warnings array is empty even for malformed HTML (parser is lenient)

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>Unclosed paragraph<div>Mixed nesting</p></div>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
Console.WriteLine(result.Warnings);
```
